# POST /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/assets

Create an issue attachment by uploading a file

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-259`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| index | path | integer | True |
| name | query | string | False |

**Request Body** (`multipart/form-data`) — `multipart/form-data`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `attachment` | file | True | must pass allowed types check, max size from setting.Attachment.MaxSize |

## Response

**201** — Attachment

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | Attachment ID |

- **413** — File exceeds max size limit

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Write access to issue attachments requires being poster, repo admin, site admin, or having write permission on issues/pulls | authorization | ctx.Doer.ID == issue.PosterID || ctx.IsUserRepoAdmin() || ctx.IsUserSiteAdmin() || ctx.Repo.Permission.CanWriteIssuesOrPulls(issue.IsPull) |
| Uploaded file type must match allowed types configured in setting.Attachment.AllowedTypes | validation | File extension or MIME type not in allowed list |
| Uploaded file size must not exceed setting.Attachment.MaxSize (in MB) | validation | file.size > maxFileSize (setting.Attachment.MaxSize << 20) |
| Upload filename can be overridden by query parameter 'name' | business_logic | ctx.FormString("name") != "" |
| After creating attachment, ChangeContent is called to trigger notifications (content unchanged) | business_logic | Always after successful upload |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| File type not in allowed list | 422 | validationError | False |
| File exceeds MaxSize | 413 | error | False |
| No write permission on issue | 403 | error | False |

### Error Paths

- **Issue not found** → getIssueFromContext → 404
- **No write permission** → canUserWriteIssueAttachment → 403
- **File type forbidden** → CreateIssueAttachment → 422
- **File too large** → CreateIssueAttachment → 413
